meta.description: Built for n8n 2.63. Groq (Llama 3.3 70B Versatile) via native AI Agent + Groq Chat Model sub-node. Supabase = Postgres node + Postgres credential (Session/Transaction pooler, SSL require + Ignore SSL Issues). Secrets via CREDENTIALS only. Import, then attach the two credentials (names below) on the marked nodes: Postgres -> the 3 'PG:' nodes; Groq -> 'Groq Chat Model'.

parameters.query: SELECT public.web_bump_rate('ip:' || $1 || ':' || $2) AS ip_hits, public.web_bump_rate('global:' || $3) AS global_hits;

WITH upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO public.web_conversations (session_key)
  VALUES ($1)
  ON CONFLICT (session_key) DO UPDATE SET last_seen_at = now()
  RETURNING id
),
ins_user AS (
  INSERT INTO public.web_messages (conversation_id, role, content)
  SELECT id, 'user', $2 FROM upsert
)
SELECT u.id AS conversation_id,
  COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('role', m.role, 'content', m.content) ORDER BY m.created_at) FILTER (WHERE m.id IS NOT NULL), '[]') AS history
FROM upsert u
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT id, role, content, created_at FROM public.web_messages
  WHERE conversation_id = u.id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20
) m ON true
GROUP BY u.id;

INSERT INTO public.web_messages (conversation_id, role, content) VALUES ($1, 'assistant', $2);
UPDATE public.web_conversations SET last_seen_at = now(), handoff = $3 WHERE id = $1;
